Risk Title: Loss of the sole cold-chain warehouse to equipment failure
Description: Failure of refrigeration equipment at the only cold-chain warehouse halts chilled and frozen deliveries.
Causes (Drivers):
* Ageing refrigeration units past their service life.
* No second site for chilled stock.
Effects (Consequences):
* Spoiled stock worth several days of sales.
* Cancelled orders and refunds.
* Loss of customer trust in fresh products.
Preventive Controls:
* Replace the oldest units on a fixed schedule.
* Add preventive maintenance contracts with 24 hour call out.
Reductive Controls:
* Agree an emergency overflow arrangement with a third party cold store.
* Keep stock insurance in force.

Risk Title: Payment gateway outage during the year end peak
Description: Outage of the single payment gateway during the year end peak stops customers from completing checkout.
Causes (Drivers):
* Single payment provider with no failover.
* Traffic spikes during year end promotions.
Effects (Consequences):
* Lost sales during the outage.
* Abandoned baskets that do not return.
* Customer complaints on social media.
Preventive Controls: * Load test the checkout before each peak season.
Reductive Controls: * Contract a secondary payment provider with automatic failover.

Risk Title: Delivery driver shortage during peak periods
Description: Too few delivery drivers during peak periods leads to late or cancelled deliveries.
Causes (Drivers):
* Gig drivers choose competing platforms during peaks.
* High driver turnover.
Effects (Consequences):
* Late deliveries and missed delivery slots.
* Lower repeat purchase rates.
Preventive Controls: * Offer peak season incentives to drivers.
Reductive Controls: * Cap delivery slots when driver numbers run low.

Risk Title: Loss of loyal customers to a larger rival's discount led subscription
Description: A larger rival's discount led subscription draws away the retailer's most loyal customers.
Causes (Drivers):
* Rival has deeper funding for sustained discounts.
* Own loyalty programme is basic.
Effects (Consequences):
* Falling repeat order rate.
* Pressure to cut prices and margins.
Preventive Controls: * Review and strengthen the loyalty programme.

Risk Title: Supplier price rises squeezing margins faster than prices can be raised
Description: Supplier price rises reduce margins when the retailer cannot pass the full increase on to customers.
Causes (Drivers):
* Imported produce prices tied to currency movements.
* Contracts reviewed only once a year.
Effects (Consequences):
* Lower gross margin.
* Reduced cash available for growth.
